observations.why: Adopting a new analytics platform appeals to novelty and self-direction — moving to something not yet in use.
Quantified performance gain appeals to mastery and capability (competence) and to winning over the current setup (self-enhancement).
Deferring migration to a scheduled future quarter appeals to stability and orderly transition rather than immediate disruption.
Summary note reiterates the performance gain as a headline benefit, appealing to capability and competitive advantage.
